content.comment_body: Hello everyone! I'm seeking help designing an uninterruptible power supply (UPS) system, controlled by a [product_name] PLC, for a 120V induction motor. I'm having trouble with programming the switching logic from line power to battery power, and ensuring the switch returns to line power only after a 20-second wait once main power is restored. I want the whole switching operation managed by [product_name] 12/24V DC, but as a beginner in PLC programming, I'm finding this challenging. Any assistance would be greatly appreciated. Thank you for your time and support! [user_name]

Hello! If I understand correctly, you need a 20-second delay when the signal to switch back to line power appears. You can use a basic "On-delay" timer for this. Check the function tree in [product_name] engineering software under "Special functions/Timer/On-Delay." Highlight this and press "F1" for further details. Kind regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user requires help programming UPS control logic using a [product_name] PLC, particularly implementing a time delay for safe power source switching. The main challenge is navigating timer functions and programming elements as a beginner within the [product_name] engineering environment.
